quest.title: Let's Go, Saury-Saury Scout!
quest.description: Thanks to recent exchanges with friends from different nations, Mika from the Reconnaissance Company has reached a new milestone...

dialogues.speaker: "Mural Maniac"
dialogues.text: Wow, young Knight, looks like you've brought our great hero over!

dialogues.speaker: Mika
dialogues.text: It's our Honorary Knight and the Helper in White! Greetings!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Mika and... a friend from Natlan? What are you guys doing here?

dialogues.speaker: Mika
dialogues.text: We're here to get the word out about something called the Saury-Saury Scout. We think it's something adventurers will find really useful.

dialogues.speaker: Mika
dialogues.text: It combines the mechanical core of the Scouting Buddy that Amber brought back from Sumeru with the adorable appearance of the little saurian toy my friends from Natlan gave me.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Scouting Buddy... Oh, yeah, Paimon remembers!

dialogues.speaker: Mika
dialogues.text: Just like the Scouting Buddies from Sumeru, the Saury-Saury Scout can be used to perform monster recon and survey unfamiliar terrain.

dialogues.speaker: Mika
dialogues.text: But due to our focus being on the latter, the Saury-Saury Scout is designed with a greater emphasis on controllability and precision of movement.

dialogues.speaker: Mika
dialogues.text: ...Are you interested in taking it on a test flight, Honorary Knight?

choices.text: That was a very serious introduction.

response.speaker: Mika
response.text: Huh? Perhaps I was a little bit nervous just now...

response.speaker: Mika
response.text: That must be it... I could swear I was more relaxed around you before.

response.speaker: Mika
response.text: It's just that I've been hearing so many stories about you from friends in other nations lately — your deeds are getting more and more exceptional...

response.speaker: Mika
response.text: Every time I think about how I need to be helpful and not get in your way, I can't help but tense up again.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: That's such a Mika thing to say...

response.speaker: "Mural Maniac"
response.text: You're doing very well, young Knight!

response.speaker: "Mural Maniac"
response.text: #Sometimes, in Natlan, when a warrior from our tribe runs into {NICKNAME}, they get so excited they just start blabbering. I've even seen folks get so overwhelmed, they can't get a single word out!

response.speaker: "Mural Maniac"
response.text: #As someone who works alongside {NICKNAME}, you're basically a legend yourself. There's no need for you to be nervous, even when talking to our chief!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: That's right! You should have more faith in yourself, Mika!

response.speaker: Mika
response.text: Hmm... I've never really thought about it from that point of view before...

response.speaker: Mika
response.text: #Anyway, {NICKNAME}, if you test out the Saury-Saury Scout and find it makes the grade, then we'll know for sure that it's a reliable, adorable mechanism that can be a big help to all sorts of adventurers!

choices.text: I'm a bit of a testing expert!

response.speaker: Mika
response.text: Fantastic! Let me just make a few final tweaks, and then you're good to go!

choices.text: Let's see what this Saury-Saury can do!
There's no need to be so formal.
